'''Uz Bonearm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] at [[Byss Bistro]]. He helped [[Shug Ninx]], [[Salla Zend]], and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] when the [[Cloning/Legends|reborn]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] attempted to take over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. He was the captain of the ''[[Bespin Bandit]]''.
